title: fp_medium u16-lane BLIS MC/KC restructure (74ba1cdc Phase 6b)
description:
Phase 6b follow-up under epic `026fc832`. 74ba1cdc R1 (commits `2ed76b4e..75826c09`) closed GF(251)/n=4096 to PASS (ratio 1.458) via L3-budget n_c_panels + a new fp_medium panel GEMM kernel, but GF(65521)/n=4096 remained SHORTFALL at ratio 1.753 (improved from 1.92 baseline). The R1 worker tried MR=3 and MR=4 register-tile variants on the new fp_medium panel kernel but both regressed (-21% and -35%) due to register spills. Closing the GF(65521)/4096 cell needs a u16-lane analogue of the BLIS MC/KC restructure already applied to Route A — multi-day work scoped to the u16 path only.

## Background

R1 fp_medium changes (`crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/fp_medium.rs`, new in commit `ba4a10e9`):
- Introduced `fp_medium_gemm_panel` with MR=2, NR=16 (chosen to fit 16 AVX2 ymm registers without spills).
- Brought GF(65521)/n=4096 from 36.34 to 39.78 Gop/s (+9.5%).
- Ratio improved from 1.92 to 1.753; PASS threshold is 1.5 → gap +17%.

The MR=2, NR=16 tile is register-pressure-limited. Closing the remaining gap requires:
1. **MC (outer rows) blocking** for fp_medium — pack A panel once per strip, reuse across NC chunks.
2. **NC (outer cols) tuning** — analogous to Route A's L3-budget heuristic but sized for u16 packed lanes (2× the memory density of f32).
3. **Either: deeper MR with explicit spill management** (use stack-allocated scratch for the accumulator tower); **or: keep MR=2 but unroll the inner loop deeper** to amortize loop overhead.
4. **Extend Barrett-reduction window** in the u16 path — currently reduces frequently; max k with no overflow can extend further.

## Scope

Restructure `fp_medium_gemm_panel` (and its hook in `gf2-core::gfp::simd_ops::fp_medium_try_gemm_panel`) with BLIS-style 3-level cache blocking + tuned register tile. Keep MR=2 unless the implementation can verify spill-free MR=3 (via `cargo asm` inspection).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] GF(65521) at n=4096: ratio gf2/fflas ≤ 1.5× on 5-trial CCX1-pinned bench (flock-guarded via `dev/benchmarks/ccx1-bench-flock.sh`) on the Zen 3 reference host. Reference: `dev/bench_results/2026-04-26-reference.csv` (fflas single-thread 69.72 Gop/s at n=4096).
- [hard] No regression on existing PASS cells at n ∈ {64, 256, 1024} for all 6 primes (delta ≤ 5%) — same protocol as 74ba1cdc R1's non-regression sweep at `dev/bench_results/74ba1cdc-r1/non-regression-sweep.txt`.
- [hard] Bit-exact correctness preserved (proptest sweep at boundary lengths {0, 1, 15, 16, 17, 63, 64, 65} for all 6 primes — extend the existing `prop_gemm_axpy_into_view_fp65521_matches_oracle` if its coverage is insufficient).
- [hard] No BLAS dependency; pure Rust + AVX2.
- [hard] Unsafe stays in `gf2-kernels-simd` (no new unsafe in `gf2-core`).
- [hard] Evidence doc at `dev/bench_results/<date>-<this-id>-fp-medium-blis.md` records before/after numbers + non-regression sweep + reproducibility commands.
- [hard] After this task lands, 98336ab4 worker re-benches all n=4096 cells; 98336ab4 closes PASS for all 6 cells.

## Out of scope

- Route A / GF(251) work (closed by 74ba1cdc R1).
- AVX-512 (epic `7f809931`).
- BLAS delegation (user-rejected).
- Multi-threading.

## Notes

- Filed session 8 (2026-05-26) per user-approved deferral of 74ba1cdc SC#2.
- Reference: 74ba1cdc R0 wall-hit evidence + R1 evidence docs (both attached to 74ba1cdc).
- Use flock-guarded benches per the established protocol (`dev/benchmarks/ccx1-bench-flock.sh`).
- Single-thread fflas reference verified per `dev/bench_results/2026-05-24-a70b1c70-phase0-controls.md:24`.
